_help: layers: id = layer id in the SVG, label = name of the switch, visible = shown at start, type = makes names clickable, items = shapes/areas makes objects clickable. Layers with the SAME label form one switch. Add "eras": ["present"] to a layer to show it only in those eras; layers of that switch without "eras" are used in all other eras. Example: { "id": "_11_Borders_Present", "label": "Province borders", "visible": true, "eras": ["present"] }
